page.overview:
What is Nightmare Realm?

The Nightmare Realm or Nightmarerealm is a realm mentioned only in the Mortal Kombat comic book, Battlewave.

The only known resident of the Nightmare Realm is Henge, a fighter who was defeated by Liu Kang.

As of Mortal Kombat X, it may be assumed that "Nightmare Realm" is an alternative name for Dreamrealm, the realm where Freddy Krueger resides.
